item.title: Seattle Mayor, police guild spar over ICE protection directives
item.description: The Seattle Police Officers Guild is refusing to cooperate with a recent directive from Mayor Katie Wilson ordering officers to investigate and document ICE activity in the city.

item.title: Seattle protesters join national ‘ICE Out’ day of action
item.description: Dozens of protesters gathered in downtown Seattle for a national “ICE Out” day of action targeting corporate ties to immigration enforcement.

item.title: Starbucks feels the heat as more chains compete for US coffee drinkers
item.description: Seattle-based Starbucks was a small, regional chain when former CEO Howard Schultz acquired it in 1987 and made it a global brand. Now, other small chains are seeing explosive growth.

item.title: Amanda Knox talks new documentary, facing the person who put her in prison
item.description: Amanda Knox and her husband, Christopher Robinson, are releasing a new documentary that revisits her wrongful conviction in Italy.

item.title: Spring-like weather in January for Seattle
item.description: Temperatures in Seattle on Saturday will be like those commonly felt in April – not January. Beyond isolated showers early Saturday, drier and sunnier weather will take over in the afternoon.

item.title: Some blind fans to experience CA's Super Bowl with tactile device that tracks ball
item.description: Some blind and low-vision fans will have unprecedented access to the Super Bowl thanks to a tactile device that tracks the ball, vibrates on key plays and provides real-time audio.

item.title: Near-record warmth hits Seattle 76 years after only zero-degree day
item.description: Seattle saw its first, and only, day with a recorded temperature of zero degrees on this day in 1950. In 2026, we are seeing temps reach a near record high for January 31.

item.title: Seattle weather: Light dusting of snow on slopes tonight
item.description: On and off showers will be possible through the weekend and are forecast to wrap up early Monday. Spring-like weather is expected next week with near record highs nearing 60 degrees.

item.title: 'ICE Out Now' demonstrators move through Seattle on Saturday
item.description: Some Seattle roads are blocked to traffic as an 'ICE Out Now" protest moves through parts of the downtown area on Saturday afternoon.

item.title: Thousands of fans fill T-Mobile Park for Seattle Mariners Fanfest
item.description: It's Fanfest time in Seattle! Families, residents and visitors came together to pack T-Mobile park to get on the field and celebrate. FOX 13 was there to chat about the season.
